title: Sign-Up Credit Posting Card for Residential Electricity Supply
content:
**Rule.** A Residential Electricity Supply plan whose sign-up credit is above 0.00 earns one sign-up credit once the agreement's completed cycles reach the plan's qualifying cycles; the credit belongs to the billing cycle that follows the last qualifying cycle, and its amount is the sign-up credit amount determined for that agreement rather than the bare plan sign-up credit.

**Completed cycles.** Completed cycles are counted as the agreement's billing cycles that carry an on-peak or an all-hours energy charge line.

**Points of judgement (hypothetical agreements).**

| Plan's sign-up credit | Plan's qualifying cycles | Completed cycles | Sign-up credit earned |
|---|---|---|---|
| above 0.00 | 3 | 2 | not yet |
| above 0.00 | 3 | 3 | yes; it belongs to the fourth billing cycle |
| above 0.00 | 3 | 6 | yes; it belongs to the fourth billing cycle |
| 0.00 | not applicable | any | no |

**Business effect.** Once posted, the agreement's bill lines carry a sign-up credit line for the billing cycle given, and the supply charges billed on the agreement are reduced by the amount credited.

## Posting action

**Capability.** `post_signup_credit_3f59f0ed` posts one sign-up bill credit to a Residential Electricity Supply agreement. A new credit line of the sign-up kind is added to the agreement's Beacon Ridge bill lines for the billing cycle given, carrying the amount as a negative (credit) value and today's posting date; it reduces the supply charges billed on the agreement and shows against that cycle in the agreement's bill lines.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool: the care agent unlocks `post_signup_credit_3f59f0ed` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `power_agreement_id` | The residential electricity agreement number that receives the credit, as read from the agreement lookup | Identifier |
| `referred_customer_id` | The customer number of a referred customer named on the line; a sign-up credit is not a referral credit and names no referred customer | Always the empty string "" |
| `billing_period_start` | The first day of the billing cycle the credit belongs to | Calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD |
| `credit_amount_usd` | The size of the credit | Positive amount in USD, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent; the line stores it signed as a negative credit |

**Return.** A confirmation sentence naming the new bill line number, the agreement, the cycle start date and the credited amount in USD. Receiving it means the sign-up credit now stands on the bill.
